These tunnels were constructed by hand, using simple tools, and were well-organized with multiple levels, trapdoors, and camouflaged entrances.

The Ho Chi Minh to Cu Chi Tunnels distance is 45km and it takes an hour and 30 minutes to transfer by car. Unlike other transports to travel to Cu Chi Tunnels such as taxis, and grab cars. By booking our Ho Chi Minh City to Cu Chi Tunnels private car, you will have a door-to-door transfer service with a basic English-speaking driver to explore the Cu Chi Tunnels.

SAIGON TO CU CHI TUNNELS PRIVATE CAR

Following your request, our Saigon private car and driver will pick you up at your desired pickup location in Saigon Center, such as your hotel, Tan Son Nhat International Airport, or any other convenient spot in the city.

If you request to be picked up at Saigon Airport, please tell us your flight number, landing time as well as the number of people so we can send a proper car such as a sedan, an SUV, or a minivan to pick you up.

Our driver will wait for you at the Tan Son Nhat airport arrival gate with your full name on a welcome board so you can recognize him. After greetings and loading the luggage, he will transfer you to visit Cu Chi Tunnels. After all, our driver will drop you off at your hotel in Saigon center.

If you stay at a hotel in Ho Chi Minh city, our driver will pick you up at your hotel and transfer you to Cu Chi Tunnels to visit. You can choose the pick up time and our driver will wait for you to explore Cu Chi Tunnels until you finish.

The tunnel network is extensive, with tunnels stretching for over 250 kilometers (155 miles) beneath the ground. These tunnels were constructed by hand, using simple tools, and were well-organized with multiple levels, trapdoors, and camouflaged entrances.

The tunnels served multiple purposes, including hiding from American and South Vietnamese troops, launching surprise attacks, storing food and supplies, and serving as a communication and transportation network.

You can explore a section of the tunnels, learn about their history, and gain insights into the life and tactics of the Viet Cong during the war. Travelling to Cu Chi Tunnels, you will learn more about the tunnels’ history, construction, and usage. You can also see various traps and booby traps used during the war.

There are museums and exhibits on-site that display weapons, equipment, and artifacts from the Vietnam War era. These exhibits offer a deeper understanding of the conflict. Plus, You will have the opportunity to try shooting firearms used during the war at an on-site shooting range for an additional fee.

After all, our driver will transfer you back to your hotel in Saigon and we finish the private car Saigon to Cu Chi Tunnels transfer. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great experience with us.

Travel Thoughts:

Respect the Site: The Cu Chi Tunnels are a historical and cultural site. Show respect for the history and the people involved in the Vietnam War while visiting. Avoid making inappropriate jokes or disrespectful comments.

Stay Hydrated: The tunnels can be hot and humid, so it’s essential to stay hydrated. Bring bottled water with you and drink regularly to avoid dehydration.

Use Sun Protection: The tropical sun can be intense. Apply sunscreen, wear a wide-brimmed hat, and use sunglasses to protect yourself from sunburn.

Crawling in the Tunnels: If you choose to crawl through the tunnels, be prepared for a tight and dark space. It’s not suitable for those with claustrophobia or physical limitations. Go at your own pace and take your time.

Photography: Ask your guide about the rules regarding photography. Some areas may not allow photography due to the sensitivity of the site. Respect these restrictions.

Leave No Trace: Do not litter or leave trash behind. Use designated trash bins for disposal.

Learn About the History: Before your visit, take some time to learn about the history of the Cu Chi Tunnels and the Vietnam War. This will enhance your understanding and appreciation of the site.
